ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI student union and campus life agent that aggregates club events, schedules study rooms, and manages peer-to-peer tutoring coordination.
ideas.title: CampusPulse Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a direct pain point felt by undergraduate judges and students daily, focusing on practical multi-step tool usage and workflow planning rather than generic chat.

ideas.pitch: A healthcare navigation and triage agent that translates complex insurance policies, matches patients with local affordable clinics, and drafts preliminary appointment intake forms.
ideas.title: CareRoute Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on human-centric AI innovation and responsible healthcare access, heavily prioritizing product clarity and workflow architecture for a non-coding pitch deck.

ideas.pitch: A personalized learning syllabus-generation agent that diagnoses student knowledge gaps and deploys specialized micro-agents for customized quiz generation and concept breakdown.
ideas.title: EduMentor Multi-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the judging criteria of exploring how AI agents plan and take actions to reach long-term educational goals, presented via a polished 10-slide deck.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous operations agent for small local businesses that monitors customer sentiment reviews, suggests automated inventory adjustments, and drafts local marketing campaigns.
ideas.title: SMB Growth Co-Pilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high economic utility and strategic product thinking, which appeals directly to idea hackathon judges looking for real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: A smart city commuter planning agent that orchestrates public transit updates, live carbon-footprint tracking, and dynamic carpooling coordination for urban student commuters.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Smart City Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines sustainable living and smart city themes into a cohesive, highly visual agent architecture schema that excels in single-round pitch competitions.
